bifrost: springboard/ui/src/assetpack.rs, springboard/ui/src/downloadqueue.rs, springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (download_task), springboard/src/shell/update.rs (OS updater only)
summary: Apps can download a file to disk with progress and cancel through the URLSession counterpart. Pure models now cover a pack manifest with local pack state, removal, language-matched pack selection and installed sizes, and a download queue with essential and non-essential priority, size budgets and saved state. Nothing is exposed to apps through the SDK yet, and nothing downloads while the app is closed: there is no downloader extension, no system scheduling, no mock server and no app-store-hosted assets.

features.note: pack manifest, local status with update detection, mark_downloaded, remove returning freed bytes, needed(). No SDK binding, no transfer, no on-disk install, no contents or file-URL lookup

features.feature: System-scheduled downloads while the app is not running (ManagedDownloaderExtension, BAAppGroupID, BAHasManagedAssetPacks)
features.bifrost: none for apps; the OS updater downloads only system updates in springboard/src/shell/update.rs
features.note: the updater is not exposed to apps; no extension and no app group

features.feature: Apple-hosted packs and App Store Connect upload
features.apple: BAUsesAppleHosting, Creating managed asset packs, Downloading Apple-hosted asset packs
features.note: tied to App Store Connect; the PC App Store has no hosted asset service

features.apple: Reducing download and storage demands with localized asset packs; AssetPackManager.resolvedLanguage, reconcilePreferredLanguages()
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/assetpack.rs (AssetPackManager::resolved_language, packs_for_languages); language tags from springboard/sdk/src/locale.rs
features.note: one resolved language per preference list, region tags match their language, unlocalized packs always wanted. Not connected to the live user language setting and no per-language file lookup yet

features.feature: Testing packs against a local mock server
Unmanaged download manager and URL downloads (BADownloadManager, BAURLDownload, BADownload)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/downloadqueue.rs (DownloadQueue: schedule, next, record_progress, complete, cancel, to_lines/from_lines); springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (download_task: dest.part renamed on success, progress, cancel)
features.note: queue model with priorities and persistence as lines; the transfer still runs only while the app is alive through download_task. The queue is not yet driven by the transfer or stored by an app
no extension that runs while the app is closed or before first launch

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/downloadqueue.rs (Budget: essential_max_bytes, max_bytes; checked by schedule)
features.note: budgets count queued downloads, not finished ones. Not enforced against the real install size on disk and not applied before first launch

features.feature: System update download with size and hash check
features.apple: not part of the framework; closest system-side analogue
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/update.rs (download(), springboard.part, verify then rename), springboard/updated/src

features.note: asset-specific error values for unknown, duplicate, empty and over-budget cases. No error codes or domains for apps
both cases; Allocated rounds each file up to the block size, and a block size of 0 falls back to logical

gaps: No app-facing asset-pack API in the SDK: the pack model exists in bifrost-ui, but apps cannot list packs, download them on demand or read their contents
No download scheduling that continues or starts while the app is closed, including before first launch (no downloader extension)
The download queue is not driven by the transfer and is not saved by the SDK, so it does not survive an app restart by itself
The size budgets are checked against queued download sizes only, not the installed size on disk and not before first launch
No local mock server for testing packs
